sources.label: PAX Gold terms and conditions, section 14

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Section 14.1 explicitly grants Paxos the ability and right to freeze and upgrade all PAXG tokens regardless of where they are held. Sections 14.2-14.5 cover legal directives, discretionary freezes, seizure, forfeiture, and destruction. Finalized Solana slot 452212686 also reports Paxos admin 2apBGMsS6ti9RyF5TwQTDswXBWskiJP2LD4cUEDqYJjk as freeze authority and permanent delegate.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: PAXG has reviewed issuer-native deployments on Ethereum and Solana. At Ethereum block 26095800 the LayerZero adapter retains owner 0x3af3e85f4f97de7ad0f000b724fb77fe5ffc024b, implementation 0xc54ca36efe594e4c774ba8463adf67ba3de1236f, and SupplyController capacity 13,320 PAXG with 0.155 PAXG-per-second refill. endpoint() and the configured peers(30168) value are observed, while the complete DVN/validator configuration and burn/mint conservation remain unresolved. Solana mint-authority attribution is confirmed by the finalized multisig read, but bridge authorization is still assessed conservatively as opaque-or-unknown.

protocols.note: Paxos calls Solana PAXG native and says existing Ethereum holders can bridge through Paxos or LayerZero Stargate, but the exact supply-conservation relationship is not yet proven.

protocols.name: LayerZero Stargate
protocols.note: LayerZero documents omnichain ERC-20/SPL transfers, but PAXG-specific endpoint, peer, DVN, and accounting configuration remains unresolved.

routes.reviewNote: PAXG is natively issued on Ethereum through Paxos SupplyControl. The canonical-side LayerZero adapter ingress/egress capability and rate limit are separately recorded in the bridge control below and do not change this route's native issuance model.

Paxos calls this a Solana-native Token-2022 deployment and the official PAXG site links the mint. W07 (2026-08-18, slot 440115731) confirmed independent native issuance: mint authority is a 1-of-4 Token-2022 multisig with Paxos admin 2apBGM…, two 177k/50s Paxos minter-controller PDAs, and LayerZero OFT store CdxPHbQ…. Native MintToken without LayerZero is observed; OFT LzReceive is an additional burn/mint transfer rail already covered by structured bridge controls. issuanceModel stays native-issuance. Remaining bridge opacity is peer/DVN/current rate-limit state, not mint-authority attribution.

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: At Ethereum block 26095800, endpoint() returns 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c and peers(30168) returns 0xace816a69b5d84f10f53cf805efe907278b544ab262bb2c2c9347c522222c530. This is a pinned configured value, not verification of the complete bidirectional peer or DVN graph.
routeChecks.rateLimits: At Ethereum block 26095800 the adapter remains an active SupplyController with capacity 13320000000000000000000 base units (13,320 PAXG), refillPerSecond 155000000000000000 (0.155 PAXG), and allowAnyMintAndBurnAddress=true.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Ethereum block 26095800, adapter implementation remains 0xc54ca36efe594e4c774ba8463adf67ba3de1236f and owner() remains 0x3af3e85f4f97de7ad0f000b724fb77fe5ffc024b. The complete DVN/validator and route pause/upgrade administrator graph remains unresolved.

controls.capDescription: The adapter's bridge SupplyController capacity and refill are distinct from the two native Paxos controller capacities; the controller-manager EOA can change adapter membership and limits immediately.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095800, getAllSupplyControllerAddresses() still includes adapter 0xd09ede557ef195983c9544a5724046fbd6e8a3c6; getSupplyControllerConfig(adapter) confirms capacity 13,320 PAXG and refill 0.155 PAXG per second. The EIP-1967 implementation and owner() match the prior review. endpoint() and peers(30168) were read without assigning a stronger bridge tier.

controls.label: PAXG Solana LayerZero OFT store

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: InitOft + RegisterOapp at slot 421037033 registered this store as an OApp on LayerZero Solana endpoint 76y77prsiCMvXMjuoZ5VRrhG5qYBrUMYTE5WgHqgjEn6. Aave's 2026-07-17 PAXG technical assessment says the Ethereum OFT has a single Solana peer and required DVNs LayerZero Labs, Canary, and Paxos. This review did not re-decode the Solana store's peer bytes or re-read Ethereum peers().
routeChecks.rateLimits: The OFT store is a threshold-one mint-authority signer and has no Token-2022 supply cap. Ethereum-side adapter capacity 13,320 PAXG / 0.155-per-second remains on paxg-ethereum-layerzero-adapter. Aave reported an inbound bound of about 4,440 PAXG per 24 hours as of 2026-07-17; that bound was not re-read on 2026-08-18.

controls.evidence: At slot 421037033 the paxosVkYu program executed InitOft and RegisterOapp, creating store CdxPHbQ… and an escrow token account for mint 5GgRAE… on LayerZero endpoint 76y77prsi…. At slot 439966894 an LzReceive on paxosVkYu cleared a message via that endpoint and mintTo'd 4.505618 PAXG with only CdxPHbQ as the Token-2022 multisig signer. PayPal's PYUSD LayerZero guide uses the same program-id paxosVkYu… for lz:oft:solana:send. This is destination-side OFT machinery on a native Token-2022 mint, not the only Solana issuance path.
